description: ol-reserved-word (issue #739): the maintainer ruling "reserved word is reserved word" extends this rule from the three registration forms (`define`/`struct`/`local`) to EVERY form that introduces a name. Each of the seven bindings here binds a Core reserved word (C19 in spec/grammar.md) through a different newly covered form — assignment's colon-place `:repeat = 1` (spec/grammar.md:103,107) and bare-place `set while to 2` (:104,108), a `for … in` binder (:127), a `map` binder and a `reduce` accumulator (:131-136), one name of a destructuring pattern (:137), and a required procedure parameter (:148) — and each raises exactly one diagnostic at that bound name's own span with `namespace: "reserved"`. Before this slice every one of these seven checked clean while `local repeat` already errored, so the rule was bypassable by omitting the optional `local` keyword. The second destructuring name `:second` and the `map`/`reduce` targets `:mapped`/`:total` are ordinary names and are deliberately not flagged, so this fixture also pins that only the reserved binder in each form is reported. `"check": true` (semantic-checker only) because this is a checker rule — nothing is executed and no events are produced.
